name: How long does replacing plumbing fixtures typically take during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: How long does replacing plumbing fixtures typically take during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple direct replacement takes a few hours, but fixtures replaced during a full remodel depend on the broader construction schedule. When replacing fixtures in an existing space without altering supply lines, installation and testing move quickly. However, if your remodel involves relocating a sink, converting a tub to a walk-in shower, or running new drain vents, rough-in plumbing must occur before wall board, waterproofing, and tile work can proceed. Fixture trim is then installed toward the final stages of the renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing fixtures in existing locations takes a few hours, but projects requiring pipe relocation or tile work are sequenced across the broader remodeling timeline.
